marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 15 knots increasing to northwest 30 late this
evening then diminishing to northwest 20 late Wednesday afternoon. Wind backing
to west 15 Wednesday evening. Snow changing to flurries Wednesday morning. Visibility 1
mile or less in precipitation. Temperatures near minus 4. <br/>
